Username:AlphaJakeYT (AlphaJakeCedar)
Reason Banned: Force Field hacks No Knockback hacks Fast Fall and Glide
Why you should Unban me: Firstly this is my second appeal for this account the first time I was told to get proof I wasn't hacking and I have some I screenshoted my .minecraft folder and have the link for it here http://imgur.com/CQuLDIN and I want to say I personally love this server and have been banned for over 3 months now and really want to rejoin the server so if you could kindly conside me this time now that I have proof that I don't hack please consider me for an Unban since I have kindly waited like I was told by another staff and yes I know that you guys have banned my brothers account for hacking too but now that won't be a issue with him getting on from the same IP I got a new computer and I don't let him on it at all so yeah I don't have to worry about that and if you could kindly consider this I would really  be thankful and could go back to playing Nebula with all my friends who were kind enough to not play it this whole time I've been banned.
